title: How do you Deal with Future Copyright Protection for Generated Asset
author: Zealousideal_Feed_41
selftext:
So far I am done with generated audios/sound for the app I am planning to make, on this current stage I have learn about the copyright issues I might face if I am not careful with generating asset.

Let's say I used a copyrighted image as a reference and I changed it completely I am still possible to face a copyright strike in the future? if i need to show the proof of prompt they will see that it came from a copyrighted reference.

Even so you are safe from copyright the rules is you cannot claim a copyright for an ai image asset. Others can copy your creation and you cannot do anythung about it because it is treated as public domain.

I am in delima I am thinking for the what could happen in the future and at the same time I am looking for answer how to deal with this. How do you guys go around with this?
